title: Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry
learningObjectives: Propagate W3C Traceparent headers across HTTP, gRPC, and message queues
Model Spans, Traces, Attributes, and Events according to OpenTelemetry standards
Configure head-based and tail-based trace sampling to control storage costs
keyTradeoffs: 100% trace sampling cost vs probabilistic sampling missing critical rare errors
Automatic framework instrumentation vs manual domain-specific span instrumentation
commonPitfalls: Breaking context propagation in asynchronous background promises or thread pools
Adding high-cardinality PII (like customer email addresses) to trace attributes
transferPrompt: How do you inject trace IDs and span IDs into structured log records for unified log-trace correlation?
